senses.gloss: interlacing, training a creeper so as to be intertwined with another plant.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:6">Tosef. Kil. I, 6</cite> <he>אסורה בס׳ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>לסַכֵּךְ</he>) must not be trained over vegetables; Y. ib. II, end, 28ᵇ <he>ס׳ שאמרו בנוגע</he> (not <cite ref="O00533"><he>סיבוך</he></cite>) the training spoken of (as forbidden) means real contact.

senses.gloss: the branches or reeds used for covering the festive booth (סוּכָּה); thatch-roof.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:9">Succ. I, 9</cite> <he>הרחיק את הס׳ וכ׳</he> if he left a space of three handbreadths between the covering and the walls.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 1:11">Ib. 11</cite> <he>לס׳</he> if the reed-mat was intended for covering the Succah. Ib. 4 <he>ואם היה ס׳ וכ׳</he> but if the covering (fit for the Succah) is larger in quantity than they (the vines trained over the Succah); a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>חריות לס׳</he> the dry twigs of the palm-tree are useful for hedges (about garden beds; cmp.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite>, quot. s. v. <cite ref="O00552"><he>סִיגָא</he></cite>).
